Parses Prometheus metrics and prints Sankey flow counts for transaction stages.

# Purpose
This script reads Prometheus-style metric text from a local file or from a URL, parses selected metric lines, and aggregates counts by metric name, kind, and optional link label. The [`scrape_url`](<#scrape_url>) function downloads text with `requests`, and [`parse_prometheus_text`](<#parse_prometheus_text>) uses a regular expression to extract metric values into a dictionary keyed by tuples. The [`get_link_count`](<#get_link_count>) helper then returns counts for a specific metric and optional consumer or sums counts across all consumers.

The main purpose of the file is to print a Sankey-style reconciliation report for a transaction processing flow. The [`print_sankey`](<#print_sankey>) function computes totals for stages such as `verify`, `dedup`, `resolv`, `pack`, and `bank`, then compares computed input and output counts with reconciliation counts from the parsed metrics. The [`main`](<#main>) function provides a command-line interface that accepts one argument, loads the metric text, prints the parsed data, and prints the report.
